label: Velocity proportional to field
subgoals: Write drift velocity as mobility times field
Multiply the given mobility and field in consistent units
Check that the field is below the velocity-saturation range

label: Conductivity and resistivity
subgoals: Write conductivity as q times density times mobility
Divide by layer thickness when sheet resistance is needed

label: Combining scattering mechanisms
subgoals: Convert each mechanism's mobility to a scattering rate as its reciprocal
Invert the sum to get the combined mobility
